events.text: Before answering, create a short TODO/checklist for yourself in whatever planning surface you normally use, then think step by step for a long time. Compare consistent hashing and rendezvous hashing precisely: structure, load balance, lookup cost, memory, replication/failover, weighted nodes, implementation complexity, and when each wins. Do not ask me questions.

Now design a lock-free MPMC queue in Rust. Cover bounded vs unbounded, cache lines, memory ordering, ABA, reclamation, blocking wrappers, batching, and validation with loom/miri/TSan. Use numbered sections.

Create a scratchpad file named crdt-notes.md with a compact outline first, then answer in chat: design a CRDT for collaborative text editing. Cover tombstones, interleaving, causal order, left/right anchoring, version vectors, and garbage collection. Think hard before answering.
